title: By-Laws
body:
## Article I — Membership & Dues

Any individual in the Pine River watershed, or otherwise interested in cleanup efforts, may join. Individual/family active membership is $5.00 per year; contributing membership is $25.00 per year. Members more than six months behind on dues are dropped from the rolls.

## Article II — Meetings

Regular monthly meetings are required. Special meetings may be called by the Chairperson, and the Board meets as necessary. Seven active members of the Task Force constitute a quorum.

## Article III — Officer Duties

The Chair provides executive supervision and presides over meetings. The Treasurer manages finances and collects dues. The Secretary maintains meeting minutes and submits quarterly reports. Bills are paid by numbered checks signed by any two of: Treasurer, Secretary, Chair, or Vice Chair. The Board of Directors elects at least three members to two-year terms.

## Article IV — Standing Committees

Three standing committees are required: Technical, Legal, and Health.

## Article V — Parliamentary Authority

Robert's Rules of Order govern all proceedings not otherwise specified.

## Article VI — Amendments

Amending the by-laws requires a two-thirds vote with 14 days' advance notice. The by-laws were last amended in February 2009 (two amendments) and September 2013.
